ALTER VIEW [DW].[FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD_View]
	AS 

WITH FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD as FDL
)

Select YTD.*
from DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD as YTD
    INNER JOIN FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = YTD.BusinessDateSK
